blockers.description: The frozen bootstrap task has contradictory capability ownership: MR-IMPL-BOOTSTRAP-001.task.capabilityId, contract.capabilityId, and IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md identify MR-CAP-160, while task.capabilityIds, TEST-MR-BOOTSTRAP-001, and MR-CAP-001's acceptance-test contract identify MR-CAP-001. MR-CAP-160 already has primary task MR-IMPL-160 for Stable Identity Across File Movement.
blockers.whyItBlocksImplementation: Wave 0 cannot produce trustworthy task, capability, test, and release-gate receipts when the foundational support task has two incompatible authoritative owners, one of which is already owned by a different primary implementation task.
blockers.resolutionRequired: Run explicit frozen-plan change control to select and apply one bootstrap support-task capability owner consistently across IMPLEMENTATION_TASKS.jsonl, IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md, implementation contracts, capability acceptance tests, dependency/ownership derivatives, and validators; then independently revalidate the full frozen authority.

blockers.description: Mandatory frozen Graphify verification fails. FINAL_FREEZE_CERTIFICATION reports failed checks BAK-01, BAK-02, BAK-03, BAK-10, and BAK-11: the recorded active immutable backup path is absent, the live Graphify scan has 13447 files versus the receipt's 13446, the backup scan has zero files, and live/backup aggregates do not reproduce the receipt. Step 11b also exits 1 because the verified active backup receipt is not the exact canonical post-Phase-9 state.
blockers.whyItBlocksImplementation: The frozen planning authority cannot be certified as the exact protected post-Phase-9 state, so it is not safe to use it as the authoritative mutation boundary for Codebase execution.
blockers.resolutionRequired: Use explicit frozen-plan recovery/change control to restore or recreate a genuinely immutable bound backup, remove or formally account for non-authoritative filesystem drift, regenerate cryptographically bound backup evidence, rerun FINAL_FREEZE_CERTIFICATION and Step 11b to PASS, and independently review the repaired frozen state. Do not delete or rewrite Graphify artifacts inside this investigation loop.
